definitionOfDone: The rendered model matches the reference silhouette, primary proportions, visible component hierarchy, material response, and most recognizable local features for the selected fidelity tier.

featureGroups.name: Overall silhouette and proportions
qualityCriteria: Bounding shape, dominant curves, negative spaces, and scale relationships are explicitly described.
failureModes: model reads as a generic placeholder instead of the reference object
major proportions are guessed without evidence

featureGroups.name: Primary structure and hierarchy
qualityCriteria: Major parts, joints, seams, contact points, and parent-child relationships are named before code generation.
failureModes: large visible parts are merged into one mesh
component hierarchy is too shallow for the observed complexity

featureGroups.name: Attachment and joint correctness
qualityCriteria: Every visible child appendage, branch, limb, handle, connector, tube, cable, horn, wing, leg, or hinged part has an attachment contract with parent socket, localStart/localEnd, contact type, embed/overlap, and gap tolerance.
failureModes: child part root floats away from the parent
branch/limb/tube is centered in space instead of pivoting from its root
parent-child transform mixes world and local coordinates

featureGroups.name: Surface material response
qualityCriteria: Albedo zones, roughness, normal/bump/displacement intent, cavity dirt, edge wear, and local overrides are specified where visible.
Important materials define independent albedo, roughness, height/normal, and AO responses instead of reusing one texture for unrelated PBR channels.
Surface response is decomposed into macro, meso, and micro frequency bands with scale and amplitude tied to object scale.
failureModes: local material variation is missing or not tied to image evidence

featureGroups.name: Reference color, material, and lighting response
qualityCriteria: Material-pass names the reference-derived albedo palette, roughness variation, tactile normal/bump/displacement response, and local masks.
When a source image is available, run reference PBR extraction and require confidence >= 0.7 before treating maps as implementation-ready.
Lighting-pass names key/fill/rim or environment light, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadow behavior.
Neutral, grazing-angle, and reference-matched renders prove that surface relief survives relighting and is not painted into albedo.
failureModes: model has acceptable shape but reads as flat shaded or plastic
colors are a generic average instead of reference-observed local color zones
lighting is evenly ambient and cannot reproduce the source value range

visualDeltaChecks: local feature placement and scale delta
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

specRefineTriggers: local feature not traceable to viewEvidence

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

mustAvoid: plastic-looking smooth bark, stone, cloth, foliage, or aged material

screenshotReview: Compare albedo palette and local color zones.
Compare cavity dirt, edge wear, stains, moss, scratches, or other local masks.
Compare key/fill/rim structure, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadows.
Capture a neutral-light render to verify material readability without reference lighting.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

assumptions: Static parked minibus; fixed wheels and doors; root pivot only, zero sockets, no destruction groups.
Rear and hidden-side details are approximate. Meshy is reference evidence only.
All custom geometry operations below are independently authored from the image; no proxy vertices, topology or materials enter the factory.

reviewHistory.summary: Deterministic review failure; no AI acceptance score. Reference and candidate use different dimensional normalization; align both to the declared asset frame before silhouette comparison. Geometry export also omitted vertex normals, causing centroid fallback on concave arches and tyres. Real wheel-centre openings remain for a separate geometry correction.

Deterministic silhouette overlap is 0.8926; no AI acceptance score. Real geometry changes required: fill wheel centres with a closed lathed tyre/hub section, and round/retract the low front fascia corners. Scale delta remains 0.1007 against 0.08; turntable detects empty wheel centres. Normal-complete self-intersection check is clean: 4320/4320 vertices.

Deterministic-only result: silhouette IoU 0.8948, aspect and scale deltas 0.0122; turntable, multi-angle and attachment pass. Self-intersection gate still flags 20 wheel-rim samples. Independent cross-section check proves all 20 sampled offset points lie outside the flat hub, indicating a gate false positive around concave rim transitions. No AI fidelity score or continue decision is issued. Further work must resolve the wheel/gate incompatibility before structural-pass.

featureReviews.notes: Coarse roof/body ratio, axle positions, sloped cab and rooftop pod read correctly. Remaining corner rounding belongs to form refinement.

reviewHistory.summary: Blockout-only review: the long high-roof mass, sloped cab face, roof AC pod and four closed wheels now establish the reference silhouette. Measured silhouette IoU 0.8948 and scale delta 0.0122 pass. Front corners remain more angular than the plate; refine in form pass. Windows, hardware and finish are intentionally absent and this is not a finished-model fidelity score. All eight deterministic gates pass without changing their thresholds.

Deterministic rejection before AI vision: trim assembly has 22 inside vertices, concentrated at overlapping mirror bracket/head and lower-front cab seal. Separate those solids with butt joints and move the bracket below the window seal. Other seven gates pass; 5416 triangles.

Deterministic rejection before AI vision: 16 trim vertices still fail. Mirror bracket-to-head gap is smaller than the gate's 5.8 mm outward probe and sharp inner cab-seal corners remain problematic. Replace two-piece mirror housing with a continuous attached volume; round cab glazing corners to remove acute seal transitions. No thresholds changed.

featureReviews.notes: Correct cab/passenger pane count, sequence and longitudinal placement; pane height and dividers require form refinement.

reviewHistory.summary: Structural-goal review, not finished fidelity: all eleven named assemblies plus repeated wheels are present, grounded and arranged as a high-roof commuter van. One cab window and two passenger panes per side, front and rear glazing, roof pod, mirrors and wheel hardware establish the required hierarchy. All eight deterministic checks pass. Passenger windows are too tall and lack dividers, rims are flat discs, nose is angular and rear remains a conservative approximation; refine those visible shapes in the next pass. Paint/livery and material response are not accepted yet.

Deterministic rejection before AI vision: turntable detects thin interior background-colored bands in the 270-degree view. Increasing body bevel from 20 to 35 mm also expanded the lateral caps into the unchanged side-glazing depth. Preserve the 0.87 m outer half-width by reducing the extrusion depth accordingly; do not relax the hole gate. Seven other deterministic checks pass, including self-intersection on vented rims.

featureReviews.notes: Main proportions remain close but cab front still has angular transitions.
Reduced pane height and real dividers now better match the source.

reviewHistory.summary: All deterministic gates pass, but visual review rejects the form at 0.79: the front-on capture shows body paint clipping the windshield upper-left corner. The windshield's authored front plane did not include the increased body bevel. Move the glazing and seal together 36 mm outward. Passenger height/dividers and real steel-rim vent holes are improved. Materials remain deferred; do not count their weak response as accepted.

Deterministic rejection before AI vision: moving the windshield/seal outward removed the previous clearance hypothesis but now self-intersection reports three trim vertices at the wiper outer tips (x +/-0.6449, y 1.1042, z 2.5825..2.5975). The wipers remained on their old front plane and intersect the relocated lower seal. Next correction should conform the wipers to the relocated windshield plane and separate them from the seal. Seven other gates pass. This is form correction 3, total correction 8; the normal per-pass ceiling must be honored. No finished visual score or promotion.

featureReviews.notes: Long high-roof commuter mass, sloped cab, arched tyre openings and AC pod hold in three-quarter and axial views. Nose remains a low-poly approximation.
Correct pane sequence and dividers, lowered passenger sill, clear windshield contour and attached wipers.

reviewHistory.supersession: 2026-09-07 renewed quality request: retract eligibility of this provisional form acceptance, without erasing its score or evidence. Current comparison material-aged-v2 shows the brow, rims and fascia require more form work. This stop action is historical only; the active run is explicitly resumed.
reviewHistory.summary: Form-stage acceptance only: the windshield is no longer clipped and its wipers clear the lower seal. Vented steel rims, window dividers, panel seams, body bevels and true arch cutouts are present and hold in orbit. All eight deterministic gates pass. This is an approximate real-time form, not exact manufacturer geometry; steel finish, lamp colors, paint age and livery remain visibly unfinished and are not accepted by this review.

Deterministic capture-route correction before AI vision: the beauty-image turntable segmenter mistakes gray steel for gray background. In its flagged rim box, 2819 of 2820 background-like pixels are covered by opaque geometry in the same-view unlit silhouette. Feed the geometric hole/coverage gate the already-captured alpha-silhouette frames, keeping the gate and its no-holes thresholds unchanged. Retain all beauty frames for appearance review. Model geometry is unchanged by this correction.

featureReviews.notes: Three faded stripe colors are present at the side sill, but the paint age and glass/steel response do not reproduce the reference. Critical feature remains below 0.85.

reviewHistory.summary: Reject material pass after eight passing deterministic checks and inspection of the reference/candidate sheet plus grazing view. The stripe is correctly ordered and follows actual split side-cap geometry; lamps are now pale and rims distinct from rubber. However, the body still looks nearly new, sill grime is too subtle, and glass/steel response is flat compared with the reference. The current shader grain and scalar changes are insufficient. Do not promote or fabricate a material-gate pass; per-region comparator/gate evidence and later surface/lighting/runtime/optimization passes remain outstanding. This correction reaches the explicitly retained total ceiling of ten. Further material work needs an overall-budget extension, not a lower fidelity threshold.

featureReviews.notes: Aging is visible; lower body is too uniformly streaked and glass interior contrast is too high.

reviewHistory.summary: Continuous paint aging and parallax interiors improve the formerly blank surfaces, but the current reference comparison still shows an abrupt roof brow, flat steel wheel discs, small low mirrors and a crude front fascia/bumper. The earlier form-only acceptance was insufficient for the user's renewed 0.85 target: reopen form refinement and preserve that verdict as superseded evidence. Seat shapes are too bright and rectangular; further material correction is needed. No claim of real interior geometry.

Deterministic self-intersection failure: mirror housing intersects the cab seal; warped dished rim caps intersect because cap triangulations differ. Fix closed-shell topology and component clearances before visual acceptance.

Mirror clearance now passes, but the hardware ray-parity gate still finds inside vertices on warped rim caps. Remove cap warping and retain the integrated raised hubs and true ventilation holes; investigate the checker probe scale separately without using a diagnostic override for acceptance.

featureReviews.notes: Rolled roof ends and rounded bumper improve form; lamp corners still stand too far proud.
Pane sequence and sliding-door rail are present; seats remain inferred material parallax.

reviewHistory.summary: All geometry gates pass with the regression-tested ray-parity correction (33 tests; original verdict preserved). Visual comparison still rejects the form: headlamps stand too far off the rounded nose; rear lamps and mirror brackets are missing; roof ribs and sill mouldings are not yet represented. Correct lamp placement and attachment before material acceptance. Photo-aligned camera diagnostic removes some misleading foreshortening but is not a geometry improvement.

One trim boundary remains inside the self-intersection probe: the right grille corner meets the headlamp bezel with insufficient clearance. Narrow each bezel from 400 to 380 mm, retaining a 5 mm visible frame around the 370 mm lamp and a 10 mm grille gap. All other geometry gates pass; 7964 triangles.

featureReviews.notes: High roof, sloped cab, long wheelbase, roof AC and proper tyre openings are clear; nose is a low-poly approximation.
Cab plus two passenger panes, dividers and sliding-door rail hold in both side views.

reviewHistory.summary: Form-pass acceptance for a budgeted procedural reconstruction, not final overall acceptance. The long high-roof mass now has rolled fore/aft ends, real roof ribs, wheel openings, closed vented wheels with raised hubs, bracketed mirrors, wrapped lamps, a rounded bumper, sliding rail and sill mouldings. These remain coherent in front, side, rear and three-quarter captures; all geometry gates pass. The single-photo rear is inferred. Material weaknesses remain visibly significant: steel too bright, windshield too dark in the photo view, interior boxes too stark, weak tire aging. Overall finished appearance is not yet 0.85; those defects remain for the material/surface passes.
Browser rejected the steel shader: patch is a reserved GLSL word. This candidate is not visually reviewed. Rename it oxidePatch and rerender; glass response also needs more highlight variation.

Material gate rejects windshield response: variance 0.00181 below 0.002 despite matching mean color. Steel now passes at crop score 0.888. Debugging finds dashboard hits do not update ray depth, fading the dashboard to the cabin background; fix that actual shader defect and reduce the opaque tint blend. Not an AI-vision acceptance.

featureReviews.notes: Chalky white paint, correctly ordered faded triple stripe and green glass are coherent across neutral and grazing views. Exact dirt patterns and internal seating are approximations.

reviewHistory.summary: Material-stage acceptance: all four observed material footprint comparisons pass (paint .910, glass .897, rubber .968, steel .888), and all geometry gates pass. Actual-photo vision confirms aged white paint, ordered faded stripes, dark tinted panes with view-dependent cabin depth, and distinct non-plastic steel/rubber response. The earlier blank glass and bright flat wheels are resolved. Surface locality still needs refinement: steel is slightly too olive/dark, tire dust is too uniform and the panel/chrome relief remains simple. This is an approximate real-time reconstruction, not reference-pixel realism; seat arrangement is inferred parallax, not interior geometry.

Surface gate finds implemented wheel-lip normal relief missing from component.surfaceDetail. Wire the actual 2.5mm radial bump and local oxidation into the hardware spec. This is a spec-completeness failure, not a visual score.

featureReviews.notes: Worn white body, faded red/yellow/green stripe order, tinted glazing and aged steel/rubber are coherent in neutral and grazing views.

reviewHistory.summary: Surface acceptance at 0.85 for a low-poly procedural match. Neutralized aged steel removes the olive cast; radial wheel-lip normal relief changes grazing highlights without new triangles. Chalk mottling, lower-panel road film, hard-boundary faded stripes, roof ribs and sill mouldings remain readable in orbit. Rounded parallax seat silhouettes are less blocky. Material comparisons remain passed (steel improved to .939), geometry and stripe-boundary checks pass, and all 16 inventoried details resolve to authored features. Limitations remain explicit: surface wear is synthesized, cabin depth is a material approximation, and the hidden rear is inferred; this is not photoreal or an exact manufacturer model.

Controlled captures and geometry gates pass, but the actual shipping preview renders the windshield almost white under its bright environment. Do not accept the lighting pass while glass loses its tint and cabin readability in the host. Reduce the glass environment/clearcoat/specular response, preserving geometry and interior depth. Shipping evidence: scratch/toyota-commuter-van/renders/beauty-hero.png.

Host inspection shows no environment map: the persistent windshield washout is a direct-light specular lobe, not environment reflection. Remove the redundant clearcoat lobe and broaden/reduce the base specular response. Previous exposure diagnosis corrected; host image still not accepted.

featureReviews.notes: High roof, cab slope, arch cutouts and wheelbase read consistently.
Cab and two passenger-window groups remain distinct under host lighting.
Faded triple stripes, chalked paint and aged running gear remain visible without glass glare dominating.

reviewHistory.summary: Lighting acceptance at .85 for a strong budgeted procedural match, not photoreal equivalence. Inspected the reference comparison, host beauty and grazing view. The former windshield-wide white highlight is gone in the actual host harness: roughness .32, zero clearcoat and reduced dielectric specular preserve green tint, wipers, dashboard and steering read. Roof curvature, ribs, AC housing, aged steel and stripe bands remain legible across the controlled view set. All deterministic gates and four material-region comparisons pass. Remaining fidelity limits are the simplified fascia, synthesized wear, parallax-only cabin and inferred hidden rear; neither low reflectance nor interior approximation is claimed as exact physical reconstruction.

featureReviews.notes: Rigid root placement preserves the reviewed shell and proportions.
Cab and passenger glazing remain distinguishable selectable batches.
Unchanged final materials and stripe geometry, confirmed by bundle hash.

reviewHistory.summary: Interaction acceptance with unchanged, hash-verified geometry and renders. The live bundled factory exposes exactly one root-pivot at the floor origin, twelve named mesh batches, zero sockets, zero colliders and zero destruction groups, matching this static parked-prop contract. A root translation preserves its rigid bounds. Actual raycasting from eight views reaches every named part (5,000 rays, zero unpicked batches); coverage has zero errors or warnings. Reviewed both side views and rear in addition to the reference comparison. Their retained .85 procedural visual match is not a new claim of photorealism. No wheel/door articulation or real cabin geometry is promised; merged painted accessories are one selectable static batch.

featureReviews.notes: High roof, tapered cab, AC pod, floor placement, axle spacing and open wheel arches establish the commuter-van proportions.
Cab plus two broad passenger-window groups, seals, rail, dividers and handles preserve the identifying layout.
Faded red/yellow/green bands, chalked white paint, lower-body film, dark green glazing and aged steel/rubber provide the reviewed surface match; no baked lighting or projected mesh materials.

reviewHistory.summary: Final overall estimated fidelity .85: strong real-time procedural match within the explicitly approved hero budget, not photoreal or exact automotive CAD. Reviewed the authoritative plate comparison, both side and rear renders, grazing response and refreshed shipping hero. The high-roof commuter silhouette, grouped passenger windows, AC pod, faded triple livery, roof/sill ribs, inset wheels, vented steel hubs and coherent aged surfaces carry the likeness. Windshield glare no longer overwhelms the cabin approximation. Actual shipping renderer measures 7,964/8,000 triangles, 12/12 draws, 4/4 materials, 12/12 geometries, zero textures and 96 ms construction with no browser errors. Existing batching and wheel instancing are retained; verification does not alter the hash-checked accepted model. Simplified fascia and parallax interior remain the main visual limitations. Hidden rear confidence .45, opposite side .65 and inferred cabin .35 remain explicit. Runtime and picking checks pass; no unrequested articulation, sockets, physics compound or destruction groups are introduced.

Lower windshield attachment regression passes: 122 actual geometry samples show 3 mm overlap instead of 123-125 mm air gap. Remaining deterministic trim gate flags one outward probe at the left wiper's bottom tip near the lower seal. Move both blades 10 mm higher on the same body-conforming surface for clean seal clearance, then recapture. No visual acceptance or new score claimed on this failed gate.

featureReviews.notes: Glass now conforms to the sloping shell instead of projecting ahead of its lower edge.
Unchanged side-window groups; windshield, seal and wipers now share actual body support.
Unchanged materials and stripes; no new surface-fidelity claim.

reviewHistory.summary: Targeted user-reported windshield attachment repair, not a claim that the earlier review caught this defect. Replaced the independent front plane with barycentric projection onto actual beveled/recessed body triangles for glass, gasket and wipers. Actual lower-edge ray tests at 122 points measure 3 mm overlap versus the old 123-125 mm air gap. Raised both wipers 10 mm for lower-seal clearance. Inspected new front, side and oblique close-ups and reference comparison: the bottom gasket now meets the white cowl, without a floating leading edge. Fresh turntable, self-intersection, attachment, interior and pass gates all pass. The .85 whole-asset procedural estimate is retained, not increased; surface and inferred-cabin limitations are unchanged. Shipping browser: 7964 tris, 12 draws, 4 materials, 12 geometries, 0 textures and no page errors. Runtime and 5000-ray picking checks pass. Permanent source-based regression demonstrably fails on the old shipped geometry and will be rerun after promotion.

Refine forms with bevels, tapers, bends, and procedural noise.
Run reference PBR extraction for important source-image materials and stop when confidence is below the target threshold.
Add material variation before adding expensive micro-geometry.

formRevision2.roof: Closed 19-vertex transverse rings at z=-2.53,-2.48,-2.32,-1.3,0,1.3,1.57,1.78,1.93,2.035; elliptical fore/aft crown roll-off removes abrupt flat brow.
formRevision2.wheels: 24-segment closed tyre lathe. Ten genuine 19mm-radius ventilation holes per 35mm-deep steel wheel. Manifold 12-sided raised center hub joins the inner cap boundary; no overlapping cap or internal wall. Planar vent annulus replaces the warped cap.
formRevision2.mirror: Rounded 150x230x60mm housing centered at y=1.16m, mounted at x=+/-0.895m through a 47mm bracket. Clears cab seal.
formRevision2.front: Wider 730x160mm four-slat grille, 370x150mm headlamps and amber corners wrapped along the rounded nose; dark lamp bezels. Closed rounded painted bumper with plate recess and paired vent inserts.
formRevision2.side: 2.18m sliding door rail at y=.925; vertical sliding-door handle; 19mm sill mouldings at y=.44/.59. Six shallow longitudinal roof ribs at x=+/-.4/.63. Conservative red/amber rear lamp stacks and rear handle (hidden-side layout inferred). Static painted-accessory batch groups these mouldings and bumper with AC pod to retain 12 draws; they move only with the root.

finish.paint: Split existing side-cap triangles at all six stripe boundaries; exact vertex-color regions without overlaid coincident surfaces.
finish.weathering: Three-octave continuous object-space chalk variation at 14-19 cells/m, elongated road-film streaks below 0.78 m; independent roughness modulation. Seeded approximation of aging, not exact photographed stains.
finish.glazing: Dark green weathered glazing with roughness 0.32, no redundant clearcoat lobe, environment intensity 0.35 and specular intensity 0.05. This art-directed rough/tinted approximation prevents direct-light white-out in the actual host. View-dependent rounded seat-back, dashboard and right-hand-drive steering-ring interior mapping; lighter front windscreen tint. Cabin depth is material parallax, not interior geometry; inferred seat arrangement confidence 0.35. Lamp colors bypass interior mapping.
finish.steelAging: Vertex color enabled for steel; scalar gray base multiplied by local gray hardware tint. Deterministic oxidation speckle, darker hub centers and six surface bolt marks per wheel. Independent roughness 0.52 and metalness 0.55; no baked illumination.

rimVents.construction: real through-holes in a closed steel extrusion

wipers.construction: conform to windshield plane above lower seal; back face meets glass outer depth 0.014

structuralConstruction.sideSurface: x = side * (0.872 - 0.023 * max(0, y - 1.1) / 0.81 + extrusionDepth); z follows authored window outline

windscreen.frontPlane: For each glass, seal and wiper vertex, barycentrically sample the frontmost actual body triangle at (x,y). z = bodySurfaceZ(x,y) - embedDepth + localExtrusionZ. This includes body bevel and corner retraction, eliminating the former 123-125 mm lower-edge air gap.
windscreen.attachmentEvidence: windscreen-attachment.json: actual bundled lower-edge glass and seal ray measurements across their full straight runs and corner transition.

mirrorHousing.construction: continuous closed housing, no overlapping bracket caps

structuralConstruction.batching: Each glazing assembly remains independently named. Rubber seals, mirrors and grille share trim; fixed rims, brackets and handles share hardware. Painted bumper, ribs and sill mouldings share the painted-accessories batch with the roof AC. Four tyres are instanced.
